diagram.documentation:
All gUFO classes with non-taxonomic relations, as imported by CCM, (excluding Disjoint With and Complement Of constraints)
The full set of gUFO classes that have relationships that are not stereotyped dependencies («Disjoint With» and «Complement Of») created by the CCM importer.

For the formal representation of majority elements on this diagram, see the UFO Formalization [Porelo et al., 2021]. gUFO adds some elements compared to the UFO Formalization, but also lacks some elements defined in the UFO Formalization. Most of the concepts are common to both however (sometimes with different names for the same concept).

 

For taxonomic relationships and Disjoint With and Complement Of constraints, see gUFO Metamodel - Classes full taxonomy per gUFO TTL incl. unions/intersections, constraints (Disjointness, Complement Of ), attributes
